acceptance.given: Package A acceptance evidence is evaluated against the declared structured integration assertions.

oracle.expected: The acceptance artifact records structured behavioral and structural assertions demonstrating validator behavior and does not rely solely on exit code, stdout ID, file existence, or plan status.
forbidden: Acceptance relies solely on stdout containing an ID.
Acceptance relies solely on a file existing.
Acceptance relies solely on a plan status string.
oracle.observable: Fresh structured integration-test output contains assertion results covering behavioral and structural evidence, including rejection of a mutated package.

acceptance.then: The acceptance evidence is behaviorally and structurally meaningful.
acceptance.when: The terminal integration test and acceptance evaluator inspect the validator result.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Preserve structured integration assertions as the required acceptance evidence and reject reliance on any single weak signal.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep the versioned validator result schema and structured diagnostic contract unchanged.

slice_hint.state_transition: Weak-signal-only acceptance becomes invalid; structured behavioral and structural evidence is required.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The terminal integration test parses fresh JSON, validates the result schema, proves reference-package pass and mutated-package rejection, and asserts evidence beyond exit code, stdout ID, file existence, or plan status.

A collision is handled only after RED.

acceptance.then: The declared ADR path is available or has been updated before RED.
